bifrost: springboard/src/shell/today.rs and springboard/src/shell/widgets/mod.rs (shell-internal Today View widgets); springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs (Notification Center column, system UI only); no app-facing widget API in springboard/sdk/src/
summary: The framework is a set of Today-widget extension classes (NCWidgetProviding, NCWidgetController, search and list view controllers). Apple's landing page marks it deprecated in favour of WidgetKit. BifrOSt has a shell-internal Today View and a Notification Center column, but no app can supply a Today widget, so none of the framework's API has an app-facing counterpart.

features.note: Display modes, margin insets and the per-mode maximum size are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-15.rs. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell renders its own widgets (battery, calendar, clock, deildu, weather and others). Apps cannot supply a widget: there is no extension point and no SDK type for NCWidgetProviding. Built 2026-10-17: SDK type sdk today_widgets::WidgetSet (ordered widgets, has-content flags, visible list); tests today_widgets::tests. Apps still have no widget view extension point. Built 2026-10-19: apps now supply widget content: they register their kinds (register or [[widget]] manifest tables) and send timelines with text, live date text and buttons, and the shell draws them as rows in the Notification Centre column (see the WidgetKit rows). Tests: widgets_timeline::tests. Still no app-drawn widget view extension point; the row is a title, a value and buttons. Midget check: click the clock in the menu bar: the rows under the title are widget rows supplied by apps (Calendar's next event, Weather, Reminders and others); a row an app registered with an Edit Widgets size chip changes height with the chip.

The has-content flag per widget is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-15.rs: unreported widgets show, empty ones are left out in order, and forgetting an app restores its widget. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Nothing lets an app tell the shell that its widget has content to show or hide, so the shell cannot hide an empty widget on the app's behalf. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by springboard/sdk/src/today_widgets.rs (WidgetSet::set_has_content, visible); tests today_widgets::tests.

The store behind the column (grouping per app, clear per app or all, the 50-entry limit) and the sheet's hidden state are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs; the drawn cards and the swipe gestures are not tested. Round (notify-stacks): groups are per app and thread, and the column's close control and Clear clear one stack (springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs DeskHit::Close, springboard/src/shell/notify/mod.rs:447 clear_group). Stack headers read 'App · thread'. Not verified on Midget. features.note: Team J (parity/team-j-notification-center): pure layout model with host unit tests: hidden widgets take no room, expanded widgets take their expanded height, and block_at finds the block under a tap point (tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-45.rs). Not wired into springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs, which still draws the notification column only; not yet tested on Midget. Built 2026-10-19: the column's widget area is now laid out by widget_column::flow (rows as tall as their family, 10 pt apart, the leading rows that end above the dock) instead of an ad hoc loop in center.rs. Tests: ui widget_column::tests (flowed_rows_stack_from_the_top_with_their_own_heights, the_first_row_that_crosses_the_bottom_ends_the_column, flowed_rows_treat_negative_heights_and_spacing_as_zero). The Block, Controller and DisplayMode layout (layout, block_at) is still not called by the shell. features.note: Parity for the deprecated framework should be judged against WidgetKit, which is outside this row. Apple itself points new work there.

gaps: No app-drawn widget view: apps send a title, a value, live date text and buttons (springboard/sdk/src/widgets_timeline.rs); the shell draws the row, and the today_widgets WidgetSet only orders widgets and keeps has-content flags.
No search results view or list view for widgets (NCWidgetSearchViewController, NCWidgetListViewController).
The Block, Controller and DisplayMode layout in springboard/ui/src/widget_column.rs (layout, block_at) is still not called by the shell; the column places widget rows with widget_column::flow.
WidgetKit (Apple's replacement) is not in the SDK; it is outside this framework but is where Apple's widget work now lives.
